question.worked_solution:
Evaluating the function at $t=2,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}r(2) & =⟨cos\,(\frac{2\pi }{2}),\,\sqrt{{2}^{3}-4},\,ln\,(2\,{e}^{0}-1)⟩ \\  & =⟨\operatorname{cos}⁡(\pi ),\,\sqrt{4},\,\operatorname{ln}⁡(1)⟩ \\  & =⟨-1,\,2,\,0⟩.\end{aligned}
$$

Computing the magnitude of this vector, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}|r(2)| & =\sqrt{(-1)^{2}+{2}^{2}+{0}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{1+4+0} \\  & =\sqrt{5}.\end{aligned}
$$
